description: Poll a pending human approval (from a flag verdict's `approval.approval_id` when the operator has configured approvals via POST /v1/approvals/config). Returns pending / approved / denied / expired; on approved it includes the signed override verdict (tag 'override:allow', valid a few minutes, bound to exactly the flagged payment). Requires TOLLWARDEN_API_KEY (the key that made the scan). This tool never handles decide tokens — deciding is the human's job via the webhook link.

approval_id.description: From the flag scan response's approval.approval_id

name: check_approval_status
